newsitem.title: USA: UNR Industries sees strong Q1, '97 demand.
newsitem.headline: UNR Industries sees strong Q1, '97 demand.

text.p: UNR Industries Inc said Tuesday it expects demand for its products to continue strong through the first quarter and all of 1997.

"Our current backlog of tower and shelter orders is at an all time high and we expect demand for our products to remain strong in the first quarter of 1997 and throughout the year," Thomas Guildehaus, president and chief executive, said in a statement.

UNR, which manufactures and installs towers, shelters, cabinets and mounts for the telecommunications industry, reported fourth quarter earnings from continued operations of $0.12 a share versus $0.08 a share last year. Revenues were $47.71 million, up from $30.96 million.
The company said its record results resulted largely from strong growth in towers and shelters to the wireless communication business, especially the Personal Communications Services (PCS) sector.
